Hi there,

I have ran gl.ibd and it has generated a plot that includes a grey area and blue line. I wanted to confirm that my assumption is correct - these are confidence intervals and the trend line respectively?

Many thanks,
Scarlett

messages.author: b3d929c6746ca81a
messages.subject: Re: [dartR] gl.ibd blue line and grey region
parts:
Hi Scarlett,

Yes this is the confidence interval of the mean response using  geom_smooth(method=lm)

Best probably described here https://rpubs.com/aaronsc32/regression-confidence-prediction-intervals and not to be confused with the prediction interval.

Hope that makes sense,
Cheers, Bernd
